flags: Hymn runs onto p75 (stanzas 4-8, doxology, Amen), final double bar on p75; no vel/ad libitum line follows.
Heading is plain AD VESPERAS with no 'a I Vesperis ... usque ad' rule printed, so only VESPERS rows (no VESPERS1), wkday null for all days of both epochs.

Director: added VESPERS1 wkday 1 (Sunday I Vespers) following the p36/p48 precedent for plain seasonal AD VESPERAS. Easter Sunday itself has no I Vespers (the Vigil replaces it); that one excess Sunday row is harmless because the Triduum/Vigil governs.
